title: Brevo business action
description: One thing a user can do in Brevo, described so an AI agent can decide when to use it and how to execute it.

category.description: Functional group, snake_case, e.g. contacts, email_campaigns.

area.description: Product area the category belongs to, e.g. contact-management, marketing-campaigns.

description.description: When an agent should pick this action. Written for a model, not a human.

preconditions.description: What must be true first, e.g. a list must exist, a sender must be validated.

inputs.description: A JSON Schema describing the arguments. Can be used as-is as a tool input_schema.

outputs.description: A JSON Schema describing what the action returns.

ui_steps.description: Fallback click path when there is no usable API.

auth.description: How auth works, described only. Never include keys or tokens.

alternative_executions.description: Other ways to do the same thing, e.g. the public API when the primary is the internal API.

errors.description: Failure cases observed on the real system, so an agent can recover without a human.

status.description: HTTP status, or 'network_error' when no response reached the client.

plan_gated.description: Minimum plan needed, if not available on free.

level.description: executed = ran on a real account; observed = seen in network traffic; documented = only in docs.

evidence.description: Pointer to a scrubbed capture or doc URL.
